tables.name: customer_point_balances
tables.purpose: Maintains the running point balance and lifetime totals for every customer who has earned points.

columns.name: customer_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify numeric customer ID

columns.name: current_balance
columns.purpose: Current redeemable point balance

columns.name: lifetime_earned
columns.purpose: Total points ever earned

columns.name: lifetime_redeemed
columns.purpose: Total points ever redeemed

tables.name: point_transactions
tables.purpose: Immutable ledger recording every points credit and debit with its source, enabling idempotency checks and audit history.

columns.name: customer_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify numeric customer ID whose balance was affected

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify numeric order ID that triggered an earning transaction; null for redemption debits

columns.name: redemption_id
columns.purpose: FK to redemptions row for debit transactions; null for earn transactions

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.purpose: Whether this transaction credits or debits points

columns.name: points_delta
columns.purpose: Signed integer — positive for credits, negative for debits

columns.name: balance_after
columns.purpose: Customer balance immediately after this transaction

tables.name: redemptions
tables.purpose: Tracks every discount code issued to a customer and its current state so double-application and concurrent redemptions can be prevented.

columns.name: customer_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify numeric customer ID who requested the discount

columns.name: discount_code_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify numeric DiscountCodeNode ID after successful creation

columns.name: discount_code_string
columns.purpose: Human-readable discount code string returned to the customer

columns.name: points_debited
columns.purpose: Number of points debited for this redemption

columns.name: discount_value_minor
columns.purpose: Discount value in minor currency units at time of redemption

columns.name: currency
columns.purpose: ISO 4217 currency code for the discount value

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Workflow status of this redemption attempt

columns.name: failure_reason
columns.purpose: Error message when status=failed

columns.name: started_at
columns.purpose: When the workflow picked up this row

columns.name: finished_at
columns.purpose: When the workflow reached a terminal state

award-points-on-order-paid.description: When an order is paid, compute and credit points to the customer's balance, guarded by an idempotency check on the order external id.

steps.purpose: null-defend customer id from payload (R3)
skip guest checkouts with no customer identity

ifTrue.message: award-points: skipping guest checkout — no customer id

steps.purpose: parse customer id to BIGINT-safe number
parse order id to BIGINT-safe number
idempotency check — look for an existing earning transaction for this order
steps.template: SELECT id FROM point_transactions WHERE order_external_id = ${orderId} AND transaction_type = 'earned' LIMIT 1

steps.purpose: skip if this order was already awarded points
load earning rate from config
compute subtotal in minor units using money helper
compute whole points to award — floor of (subtotal in major units * earningRate)
skip zero-point awards (very small orders or rate rounds to zero)

ifTrue.message: award-points: zero points computed — skipping ledger write

steps.purpose: atomically upsert balance and append ledger row with row-level locking
upsert customer balance, locking the row to prevent concurrent-credit loss
steps.template: INSERT INTO customer_point_balances (customer_external_id, current_balance, lifetime_earned, lifetime_redeemed, updated_at) VALUES (${customerId}, ${pointsToCredit}, ${pointsToCredit}, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (customer_external_id) DO UPDATE SET current_balance = customer_point_balances.current_balance + ${pointsToCredit}, lifetime_earned = customer_point_balances.lifetime_earned + ${pointsToCredit}, updated_at = now() RETURNING current_balance

steps.purpose: append immutable earning transaction to the ledger
steps.template: INSERT INTO point_transactions (customer_external_id, order_external_id, redemption_id, transaction_type, points_delta, balance_after) VALUES (${customerId}, ${orderId}, NULL, 'earned', ${pointsToCredit}, ${balanceAfter}) ON CONFLICT (order_external_id) DO NOTHING

steps.purpose: structured success log for timeline reconstruction (R8)

postconditions: Exactly zero or one earning transaction rows exist per order_external_id.
customer_point_balances.current_balance equals the sum of all positive points_delta values minus all negative points_delta values in point_transactions for that customer.
Guest checkouts produce no ledger or balance rows and no error.
edgeCases: Duplicate orders/paid webhook for the same order — existingTx check exits before any write.
Two orders paid concurrently for the same customer — the sql_transaction upsert uses SQL addition (not read-modify-write) so both credits land without loss.
Subtotal so small that floor(subtotal * rate) = 0 — recipe exits without writing a zero-point ledger row.
Guest checkout (customer is null) — detected by null-defense compute on payload.customer.id; recipe exits early with an info log.

widget-get-points-balance.description: Return the authenticated customer's current point balance and redemption eligibility for the storefront widget.

steps.purpose: reject unauthenticated requests with no customer identity

ifTrue.purpose: return ineligible empty response for unresolved identity

steps.purpose: parse customer id to number
load redemption threshold from config
load discount value minor units from config
fetch customer balance row
steps.template: SELECT current_balance FROM customer_point_balances WHERE customer_external_id = ${customerId} LIMIT 1

steps.purpose: resolve current balance, defaulting to zero if no row yet
assess redemption eligibility — must meet threshold and have no concurrent pending redemption
return balance and eligibility to widget

postconditions: Returns 200 in all cases — unknown customer id returns zero balance and ineligible.
redemption_eligible reflects current_balance >= configured redemption_threshold at read time.

customerId is null (guest or unauthenticated session) — returns safe empty response with status 200.

widget-redeem-points.description: Debit the customer's points by the redemption threshold, insert a pending redemption record, and enqueue the discount code creation job.

steps.purpose: reject requests with no resolvable customer identity
parse customer id to number
load redemption threshold from config
load discount value minor units from config
load currency code from config
detect any in-progress pending redemption for this customer to block concurrent redemptions
steps.template: SELECT id FROM redemptions WHERE customer_external_id = ${customerId} AND status = 'pending' LIMIT 1

steps.purpose: reject if a concurrent redemption is already pending

ifTrue.purpose: return 409 to indicate a redemption is already in progress

body.error: a redemption is already in progress for this customer

steps.purpose: atomically debit points from balance — rejects if balance is insufficient (R1)
steps.template: UPDATE customer_point_balances SET current_balance = current_balance - ${threshold}, lifetime_redeemed = lifetime_redeemed + ${threshold}, updated_at = now() WHERE customer_external_id = ${customerId} AND current_balance >= ${threshold} RETURNING id, current_balance

steps.purpose: return 422 if the balance claim returned no rows (insufficient balance)
capture new balance after debit
atomically insert the pending redemption row and the debit ledger transaction
create the pending redemption record
steps.template: INSERT INTO redemptions (customer_external_id, points_debited, discount_value_minor, currency, status) VALUES (${customerId}, ${threshold}, ${discountValueMinor}, ${currency}, 'pending') RETURNING id

steps.purpose: append immutable debit transaction to the ledger
steps.template: INSERT INTO point_transactions (customer_external_id, order_external_id, redemption_id, transaction_type, points_delta, balance_after) VALUES (${customerId}, NULL, ${redemptionId}, 'redeemed', ${negThreshold}, ${balanceAfterDebit})

steps.purpose: queue the Shopify discount code creation job for async processing
return 202 with the redemption id so the widget can poll for the code

postconditions: Exactly one pending redemption row created per successful request.
Customer balance is debited by exactly redemption_threshold before the response is sent.
One debit ledger row written per redemption with negative points_delta.
Concurrent duplicate requests for the same customer are blocked by the pending-redemption check.
edgeCases: Customer balance exactly meets threshold but concurrent redemption is pending — pendingRedemptions check returns 409 before any debit.
Insufficient balance — sql_claim WHERE current_balance >= threshold returns zero rows; recipe returns 422 without inserting any rows.
Unauthenticated request (customerId null) — rejected with 401 before any DB access.
Network retry of a POST after the first enqueue succeeded — pending redemption row exists so the second call hits the 409 guard.

process-redemption.description: Claim a pending redemption, create the Shopify discount code, mark complete; on failure restore the customer's balance and mark failed.

steps.purpose: claim, create discount code, and finalise redemption via workflow helper
steps.expression: await workflow.attempt('redemptions', redemptionId, { from: 'pending', to: 'completed', startedAtColumn: 'started_at', finishedAtColumn: 'finished_at' }, async (row) => { const customerGid = `gid://shopify/Customer/${row.customer_external_id}`; const discountValueDecimal = money.format(row.discount_value_minor, row.currency); const code = `LOYALTY-${row.id.slice(0,8).toUpperCase()}`; const result = await shopify.graphql(`mutation CreateLoyaltyDiscount($input: DiscountCodeBasicInput!) { discountCodeBasicCreate(basicCodeDiscount: $input) { codeDiscountNode { id codeDiscount { ... on DiscountCodeBasic { codes(first: 1) { nodes { code } } } } } userErrors { field message } } }`, { input: { title: `Loyalty Reward ${code}`, code: code, startsAt: new Date().toISOString(), endsAt: null, appliesOncePerCustomer: true, usageLimit: 1, customerGets: { items: { all: true }, value: { discountAmount: { amount: discountValueDecimal, appliesOnEachItem: false } } }, customerSelection: { customers: { add: [customerGid] } } } }); if (result.discountCodeBasicCreate.userErrors.length > 0) { throw new Error(result.discountCodeBasicCreate.userErrors.map(e => e.message).join('; ')); } const discountNodeGid = result.discountCodeBasicCreate.codeDiscountNode.id; const discountNodeId = Number(discountNodeGid.split('/').pop()); const discountCodeStr = result.discountCodeBasicCreate.codeDiscountNode.codeDiscount.codes.nodes[0].code; await sql`UPDATE redemptions SET discount_code_external_id = ${discountNodeId}, discount_code_string = ${discountCodeStr} WHERE id = ${redemptionId}`; return { discountCodeStr, discountNodeId }; }, { fail: async (row, reason) => { await sql`UPDATE customer_point_balances SET current_balance = current_balance + ${row.points_debited}, updated_at = now() WHERE customer_external_id = ${row.customer_external_id}`; await sql`INSERT INTO point_transactions (customer_external_id, order_external_id, redemption_id, transaction_type, points_delta, balance_after) SELECT ${row.customer_external_id}, NULL, ${row.id}, 'compensating_credit', ${row.points_debited}, cpb.current_balance FROM customer_point_balances cpb WHERE cpb.customer_external_id = ${row.customer_external_id}`; } })

steps.purpose: log outcome — null means the row was already claimed by another runner

ifTrue.message: process-redemption: row already claimed by another worker

ifFalse.message: process-redemption: discount code created and redemption completed

postconditions: On success: redemption.status='completed', discount_code_external_id and discount_code_string set, point_transactions row unchanged.
On failure: redemption.status='failed', failure_reason set, customer balance restored by points_debited, compensating_credit ledger row appended.
Race condition: second runner finds row not in 'pending' state and exits without side effects.
edgeCases: Shopify returns userErrors on discount code creation — workflow.attempt's fail callback restores balance and appends compensating_credit before marking failed.
Two cron runners pick up the same redemption_id — workflow.claim atomicity ensures only one proceeds; the other gets null and exits.
Row is already in completed or failed state when cron fires — claim returns null; recipe logs and exits cleanly.

steps.purpose: sweep stale running redemption rows older than 15 minutes
log count of swept rows for ops visibility

edgeCases: No stale rows — sweepStale returns empty array; log shows swept_count=0.

platformGaps.gap: No synchronous Shopify discount code creation within an HTTP request budget — discount creation involves a Shopify mutation that may exceed the 2-second HTTP compute budget at scale.
platformGaps.mitigation: Redemption request inserts a pending row, debits points synchronously, and enqueues process_redemption job; the widget polls /points-balance for a status update until the code appears.
platformGaps.uxImplication: After clicking Redeem, the customer sees a 'processing' state; the discount code is displayed only after the cron job completes, typically within seconds.

platformGaps.gap: Shopify discount code API does not support batch creation — each redemption requires one API call.
platformGaps.mitigation: Each process_redemption cron job handles one redemption atomically via workflow.attempt; no batching is needed because redemptions are individually enqueued.

uxExpectations.storefront: Widget renders the customer's current point balance and a clear threshold progress indicator; when eligible, a single 'Redeem for $X off' button triggers redemption and transitions to a 'code pending' state, then displays the generated discount code once processing completes.
uxExpectations.admin: Admin dashboard prioritises a settings panel for earning rate, threshold, and discount value at the top, followed by a scrollable paginated leaderboard of customer balances showing current balance and lifetime totals so the merchant can audit program activity.

edgeCases: Shopify rejects the discount code creation after points are already debited — the workflow.attempt fail callback restores the customer's balance in customer_point_balances and appends a compensating_credit row to point_transactions so the ledger remains consistent.

Two concurrent orders/paid webhooks for the same order external id arrive simultaneously — the UNIQUE constraint on point_transactions.order_external_id causes the second INSERT to be silently ignored via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, and the idempotency SELECT at recipe start causes the second webhook to exit before reaching the transaction block.

Two simultaneous redemption POST requests from the same customer — the pending-redemption SELECT check plus the balance sql_claim WHERE current_balance >= threshold together ensure only one debit can proceed; the second request receives a 409 or 422.

Merchant raises the redemption threshold after customers have partially accumulated points — existing balance rows are unchanged; customers whose balance no longer meets the new threshold see redemption_eligible=false in the widget until they earn more points.

A redemption row is stuck in 'pending' due to a cron worker crash — the sweep_redemptions job at */10 * * * * flips rows older than 15 minutes to 'failed', and the fail callback restores the balance so the customer can retry.

Customer with no point_transactions and no customer_point_balances row calls /widget/points-balance — the sql_select returns zero rows; the recipe returns current_balance=0 and redemption_eligible=false without error.
